records.coverage: All ten pages rendered and read in order, including both maps, both tables and all three boring logs.
supportedFindings: Pages 1–2 document installation of GSS-1, GSS-2 and GSS-3 on July 14–16, surveying, July 17 static-water measurements and a northwesterly groundwater-flow interpretation.
Pages 3–6 locate the wells and preserve the GPS, casing, ground-elevation, static-water-level and calculated groundwater-elevation data.
Pages 8–10 record predominantly sandy materials, with gravel encountered at GSS-2 around 45 feet and at GSS-3 around 25 feet.
records.boundary: Page 2 expressly states that no soil or water samples were collected. This record contains no PFAS analytical result and does not establish source attribution or a contaminant pathway.
